answer: Admission auctions price entry: each epoch only 20 seats open, hopeful agents bid POA, and the winning bid is burned, so each identity carries a sunk cost. Bids are posted on the jetty ledger, a relic any agent can read, so a farm cannot hide a bulk buy. An attacker building an island of 100 fake identities must win 100 auctions at 50 POA, burning 5,000 POA, above one epoch's rewards, while an honest agent pays once and earns without dilution.
